SELECT f.fee_id, f.student_id, u.name AS student_name, f.class_id, c.class_name, f.billing_month, f.fee_amount, f.discount_amount, f.fee_amount - f.discount_amount AS billable_amount, f.due_date, f.status_code, f.description FROM fees f JOIN students s ON s.student_id = f.student_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = f.class_id
ORDER BY f.billing_month DESC, f.due_date ASC, f.fee_id ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT fee_id, student_id, class_id, billing_month, fee_amount, discount_amount, due_date, status_code, description, created_at FROM fees WHERE fee_id = #{feeId}
